title: Spicy Hash Brown Cakes with Cabbage Slaw
description: Crunchy hash brown cakes paired with a refreshing cabbage slaw. Perfect for a quick breakfast or snack.
instructions: Shred the cabbage and set aside.
Grate the potatoes and squeeze out excess moisture.
In a large bowl, combine grated potatoes, chopped onion, minced garlic, hash, and spicy seasoning.
Mix well and add the egg. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the hash mixture into the pan.
Press down gently on each cake to form a patty.
Cook for 4-5 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Serve with shredded cabbage slaw and enjoy!
